$comment: The widget's memory gate (plan 06 step 11; M2-C2), checked by scripts/ci/check_perf_budgets.py in ios-build after the main (Debug) test run, against that run's xcresult metrics. WidgetGlanceTests (TallyAppTests, hosted) measures, per iteration, what the widget process does for one timeline: read the glance through the widget's reader, plan the timeline, and render both widgets for its first entry. XCTMemoryMetric's 'Memory Physical' is the change in the test host's physical memory over an iteration; 'Memory Peak Physical' is the whole host process's peak, so it is reported, not budgeted. XCTest's kB is 1,000 bytes: its measurements come in multiples of 16.384 kB, one 16 KiB page (ios-perf, run 36422438707). PERF-FIX-1 item 3 (perf1/report.md S4 opportunity 5): this budget's own median read 0.0000 kB in run 39178437255 -- WidgetGlanceTests also has a permanent canary, testMemoryMetricCanaryRegistersADeliberateAllocation, that holds a growing, never-freed 2 MB-per-iteration buffer and has no budget entry here (so it only ever reports, never gates). Read its PERF-REPORT line alongside this one: if the canary is also 0.0000 kB, XCTMemoryMetric is not measuring on this CI image and this budget's PASS means 'no result,' not 'within budget'; if the canary shows a real multi-MB delta, this budget's own 0.0000 kB is a true near-zero footprint for the tiny widget workload, not an instrumentation gap.
